_finding: The B20 reads (docs/b20-transfers-tz.md §1, §5, outside review of #268): pinned by block hash with requireCanonical, stamped with the block's own time and never with ours, a head below the last one used or ahead of the clock refused, every aggregate3 answer decoded strictly, policyExists before isAuthorized and once per id, the second RPC when the first fails, a baseline that keeps the last value read so a failed sub-call never hides a change, and the wallet read refused when its head is old, behind the reading, or the policy moved. The bounds and success-word checks of the decoder are held by its canonical re-encoding, which is locked.

mutations.name: isAuthorized is asked of an id that does not exist
mutations.find: if (id != null && id !== ALWAYS_ALLOW && exists[id] === true) pairs.set
mutations.expect: FAIL an unknown id is never asked isAuthorized

mutations.name: the pin does not ask requireCanonical
mutations.find: export const pinOf = (hash) => ({ blockHash: hash, requireCanonical: true })
mutations.expect: FAIL every eth_call is aggregate3 at the pinned block hash, canonical only

mutations.name: a reading is stamped with our clock
mutations.find: token: p.t.address, block: head.number, block_hash: head.hash, read_at: head.time,
mutations.replace: token: p.t.address, block: head.number, block_hash: head.hash, read_at: now(),
mutations.expect: FAIL a node whose head is an hour old

mutations.name: a head ahead of the clock is taken
mutations.find: try { const head = await pinHead(fetchImpl, url); if (head.time <= now() + FUTURE_SKEW_MS) heads.push({ url, head });
mutations.replace: try { const head = await pinHead(fetchImpl, url); if (true) heads.push({ url, head });
mutations.expect: FAIL a node whose head is an hour ahead of our clock

mutations.name: a head below the last one used is taken
mutations.find: if (head.number < minBlock) throw new Error('rpc: head below the last block read')
mutations.expect: FAIL the first node down, the second behind the last block used

mutations.name: an id shared by tokens is read once per token
mutations.find: const ids = [...new Set(per.flatMap((p) => Object.values(p.policies)).filter((id) => id != null && id !== ALWAYS_ALLOW))]
mutations.replace: const ids = per.flatMap((p) => Object.values(p.policies)).filter((id) => id != null && id !== ALWAYS_ALLOW)

mutations.name: the second RPC is never tried
mutations.expect: FAIL the first RPC down: the second answers

mutations.name: the baseline is never moved on
mutations.expect: FAIL the next cycle, the same rules: no new change

mutations.name: a failed sub-call resets the baseline
mutations.find: const pick = (a, b) => (b === true || b === false ? b : a)
mutations.expect: FAIL the cycle whose sub-call failed

mutations.name: the pause disagreement is journaled every cycle
the wallet read takes an old head
mutations.expect: FAIL a head an hour old by its header time

mutations.name: the wallet read takes a head behind the reading
mutations.expect: FAIL a head below the reading

mutations.name: the wallet read is built on an id that moved
mutations.find: if (idOf(r[0]) !== ids.receiver || idOf(r[1]) !== ids.sender) return { head_block: head.number, receive: null, send: null }
mutations.expect: FAIL the bound id changed since the reading

mutations.name: the answer is not held to its canonical encoding
mutations.find: if (encodeAggregate3Result(out).toLowerCase() !== hex.toLowerCase()) throw new Error('aggregate3: not the canonical encoding of its own results')
mutations.expect: FAIL a tuple offset pointing back at another tuple

mutations.name: the first node is read whatever its age
mutations.find: heads.sort((a, b) => b.head.time - a.head.time || b.head.number - a.head.number)
mutations.expect: FAIL the first node an hour behind, the second current

mutations.name: an old head moves the baseline
mutations.expect: FAIL every node an hour behind

mutations.name: the wallet read takes a head ahead of the clock
mutations.expect: FAIL the wallet read refuses a head an hour ahead of the clock
